# Call Center Staffing

> Specialized recruiting for call centers, BPOs and CX teams. Onshore (US), nearshore (Mexico), offshore (Philippines). Founded 2003. 90-day attrition guarantee on every placement.

Call Center Staffing (callcenterstaffing.net) is a B2B recruiting agency placing contact-center, BPO and CX talent — agents, supervisors, QA, WFM, trainers and operations leadership — across 14 countries. Buyers are operations leaders at in-house contact centers and BPOs globally.

## About

- [About](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/about): What we do, who we serve, and how we differ from generalist staffing firms.
- [How we work](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/how-we-work): Six-stage screen, cohort planning, and 90-day retention support.

## Solutions

- [Scaling an Existing Call Center](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/scaling-existing-call-center): Backfill attrition, ramp seats and protect SLAs. We embed with your ops team to run continuous recruiting at the cadence your forecast demands.
- [Launching a New Call Center](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/launching-new-call-center): Greenfield call center builds across onshore, nearshore and offshore. From first 25 to first 250 — recruited on the calendar your launch demands.
- [Seasonal & Surge Staffing](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/seasonal-surge): Pre-built bench for Q4, open enrollment, tax season and product launches. Recruit ahead of demand, ramp on schedule, demobilize cleanly.
- [BPO & Outsourcer Staffing](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/bpo-staffing): Headcount for outsourcers running multi-client floors with strict quality standards. Per-client cohort owners, calibrated quality, and pipeline that holds.
- [Direct-to-Employer Staffing](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/direct-to-employer): Permanent hires placed directly into in-house contact centers, not vendor floors. Senior-recruiter screening, real cohort fit, and 90-day attrition guarantees.
- [Compliance & Licensed Roles](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/compliance-licensed): NMLS, state-insurance, HIPAA and PCI-cleared agents — vetted to your regulator, not just your scorecard. Active pipelines for healthcare, financial services and insurance.

## Locations

- [Mexico](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/locations/mexico): Place bilingual call-center agents in Guadalajara, Mexico City and Monterrey. CT/ET overlap and onshore-grade quality.
- [Philippines](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/locations/philippines): Recruit native-English call-center agents in Manila, Cebu and Davao. 24/7 coverage and mature CX infrastructure.

## Roles

- [Bilingual Call Center Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/bilingual-agents): Place bilingual call-center agents across onshore, nearshore and offshore markets. Tested for accent neutrality, language fluency and CX skills.
- [Inbound Customer Service Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/inbound-customer-service): Recruit inbound customer-service agents at scale across regions. Screened for empathy, AHT discipline and first-call resolution.
- [Outbound Sales Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/outbound-sales-agents): Recruit outbound sales agents who close. Screened for tonality, objection handling, conversion discipline and CRM speed across B2C and B2B verticals.
- [Team Leads & Supervisors](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/team-leads-supervisors): Recruit team leads and supervisors who run a floor. Screened for shrinkage discipline, coaching skill, and adherence — not just tenure.
- [QA Analysts](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/qa-analysts): Recruit QA analysts with calibrated scoring discipline. Screened for inter-rater agreement, root-cause analysis, and coaching follow-through.
- [Workforce Management](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/workforce-management): Recruit WFM analysts, real-time analysts and WFM managers. Screened for forecast accuracy, intraday discipline, and Erlang fluency.
- [Trainers & QA Coaches](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/trainers): Recruit trainers and QA coaches who shorten ramp and lift week-4 quality scores. Screened for delivery, retention design, and coaching transfer.
- [Operations Managers](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/operations-managers): Recruit ops managers who run a floor on the numbers. Screened for P&L literacy, leadership cadence, and span-of-control discipline.
